home.title: BetterIriga.org | Public Guide & Civic Transparency for Iriga City
home.description: Independent community guide for Iriga City, Camarines Sur. Find City Hall services, 24/7 hotlines, elected officials, 36 barangays, budget summaries, projects, ordinances, and the Freedom Wall.

services.title: All Iriga City Services & Citizen's Charter Guide
services.description: Browse step-by-step requirements for Iriga City Hall services across 29 offices — Birth/Marriage/Death Certificates, Business Permits, Real Property Tax, Cedula, Building Permits, Senior/PWD IDs, Health Permits, and PESO Jobs.

officials.title: City Officials, Department Heads & 36 Barangays
officials.description: Plain-language guide to Iriga City's 2025–2028 elected leaders (Mayor Wilfredo Rex C. Oliva, Vice Mayor Edsel S. Dimaiwat, and 10 City Councilors), 17 department heads, and all 36 barangays.

budget.title: City Budget, Public Funds & Audit Guide
budget.description: Plain-language guide to Iriga City's annual budget, National Tax Allotment (NTA) shares (2022–2025 reaching ₱913.50M), mandatory community funds, and public audit reports.

projects.title: Projects, Public Works & Social Programs
projects.description: Plain-language guide to ongoing and completed infrastructure projects, public works, and social welfare programs in Iriga City.

ordinances.title: City Laws, Ordinances & Resolutions
ordinances.description: Plain-language guide to Iriga City ordinances and resolutions, including the 2023–2032 Land Use Plan, Revenue Code, Tourism Code, Plastic Ban, and Mandatory CCTV Ordinance.

legislative.title: Sangguniang Panlungsod & City Legislation
legislative.description: Official legislative guide to the Sangguniang Panlungsod of Iriga City, presiding officer Vice Mayor Edsel Dimaiwat, city councilors, and enacted ordinances & resolutions.

statistics.title: City Statistics & Key Data Indicators | BetterIriga.org
statistics.description: Official population statistics, PSA demographics, barangay breakdowns, DBM revenue allocations, and DTI CMCI competitiveness rankings for Iriga City.

contacts.title: City Hall Phonebook, 29 Offices & 24/7 Emergency Hotlines
contacts.description: Tap-to-call phone numbers ((054) 299-xxxx), email addresses for all 29 Iriga City Hall offices, 24/7 CDRRMO emergency rescue numbers, and official Facebook pages.

freedomWall.title: Community Freedom Wall | BetterIriga.org
freedomWall.description: Leave an anonymous sticky note on the BetterIriga.org Community Freedom Wall. Share your thoughts, ideas, and stories with fellow Irigueños.

home.heroBadgePrefix: Public Guide for Iriga City Residents
home.heroTitleMain: Clear, Honest Public Information for Every Irigueño
home.heroSubtitle: Find City Hall services, Citizen's Charter steps, 24/7 emergency hotlines, your elected leaders, 36 barangay captains, city ordinances, public works projects, budget summaries, and the Community Freedom Wall — written in plain, everyday language and backed by official records.

home.searchPlaceholder: What are you looking for? (e.g., Birth Certificate, Business Permit, Mayor's Office phone, CDRRMO hotline, Tourism Code...)
home.pillarsHeading: What Would You Like to Do Today?
home.pillarsSubheading: Choose a topic below to check Iriga City Hall service steps, look up verified public records, or leave a sticky note on our community wall.

pillars.title: 1. What City Hall Service Do You Need?
pillars.description: Step-by-step plain-language guides for Birth/Marriage/Death Certificates, Business Permits, Real Property Tax, Cedula, Building Permits, Senior/PWD/Solo Parent IDs, Health Permits, and PESO Jobs.

pillars.title: 2. Who Leads Our City & Barangays?
pillars.description: Meet City Mayor Wilfredo Rex C. Oliva, Vice Mayor Edsel S. Dimaiwat, the 10 City Councilors (2025–2028), 17 City Hall Department Heads, and all 36 Barangay Captains.

pillars.title: 3. How Much Is Iriga City's Budget?
pillars.description: See how much funding Iriga City receives from the national government (₱913.50M in 2025), how the law requires it to be spent on development and disaster readiness, and which reports are available.

pillars.title: 4. What Projects & Programs Are Happening?
pillars.description: Track ongoing and completed roads, buildings, hospital plans, 5th District public works (from BetterGov.ph), senior citizen pensions, and Agta community programs.

pillars.title: 5. What Are Iriga City's Local Laws?
pillars.description: Read plain-language summaries and download official copies of Iriga City ordinances — including the plastic bag ban, mandatory business CCTV rules, revenue code, and tourism code.

pillars.title: 6. How Do I Contact a City Office or Hotline?
pillars.description: Get tap-to-call landline numbers ((054) 299-xxxx), email addresses for all 29 City Hall offices, 24/7 CDRRMO rescue numbers, and official Facebook links.

pillars.title: 7. Leave a Sticky Note on the Freedom Wall
pillars.description: Share what's on your mind — leave an anonymous sticky note on our interactive community canvas. Your thoughts, ideas, and stories stay right here on BetterIriga.org.

pillars.title: 8. How Do I Know This Information Is Accurate?
pillars.description: Visit our dedicated Source Checklist page to see where every single number comes from, when it was last checked, and why unverified items are marked openly.

home.betterGovHighlightTitle: Backed by Official City Records & BetterGov.ph Public Data
home.betterGovHighlightSubtitle: Alongside Iriga City Hall's official website and national agencies (DBM, PSA, DILG), BetterIriga brings together public works and road projects tracked by BetterGov.ph for Iriga City and Camarines Sur's 5th District (Rinconada).

services.eyebrow: Iriga City Citizen's Charter & Public Service Guide
services.title: All Iriga City Government Services in Plain Language
services.subtitle: Need a Birth Certificate, Business Permit, Real Property Tax receipt, Senior Citizen or PWD ID, Building Permit, Medical Certificate, or Job Referral? Browse all verified services across Iriga City Hall's 29 offices below.

officials.title: City Officials, Department Heads & 36 Barangays
officials.subtitle: Here you can find the people serving Iriga City — from the Mayor, Vice Mayor, and 10 City Councilors elected for 2025–2028, to the heads of City Hall departments and the Punong Barangay (Captain) of each of our 36 barangays.

budget.title: Where Does Iriga City's Public Money Come From?
budget.subtitle: Every year, Iriga City receives its National Tax Allotment (NTA) share from national taxes collected across the Philippines, as reported by the Department of Budget and Management (DBM) and tracked by BetterGov.ph.

projects.title: Projects & Programs Across Iriga City
projects.subtitle: Explore roads, multi-purpose buildings, commercial hubs, and social welfare programs in Iriga City — combining official City Hall updates with Camarines Sur 5th District public works tracked by BetterGov.ph.

ordinances.title: City Ordinances & Resolutions in Plain Language
ordinances.subtitle: An Ordinance is a local law passed by the City Council, while a Resolution expresses an official policy or approval. Browse verified measures below and download their official PDF copies.

legislative.title: Sangguniang Panlungsod & City Ordinances
legislative.subtitle: Meet the presiding officer Vice Mayor Edsel Dimaiwat, elected city councilors, and browse verified local ordinances and resolutions with direct citations.

statistics.title: Iriga City Statistics & Key Indicators
statistics.subtitle: Explore official population demographics from PSA, city revenue allocations from DBM, economic indicators, and DTI CMCI competitiveness rankings.

contacts.title: Offices, Hotlines & Official Social Pages
contacts.subtitle: Need to call an office at Iriga City Hall or reach emergency responders? Tap any phone number or email below to connect directly.

freedomWall.title: Irigueño Freedom Wall
freedomWall.subtitle: Leave an anonymous sticky note on our community canvas. Pan and zoom around the board, read notes from fellow Irigueños, or tap '+ Add Note' to share what's on your mind.

about.title: Built for Irigueños, Backed by Official Sources
about.subtitle: BetterIriga.org is a volunteer-run public information portal under BetterGov.ph, alongside sibling platforms BetterLibmanan.org, BetterSolano.org, BetterOrmoc.org, BetterLasPinas.org, and BetterBacolod.org. We never guess or invent data.

verification.title: How We Check Every Fact on BetterIriga.org
verification.subtitle: This dedicated page shows where every single public record on BetterIriga.org comes from, when it was last checked, and which government documents are still awaiting online publication.
